verdict.rationale: The app documents its own account sign-in: a device-code flow approved at omnirush.ai/console, after which the agent uses the models in the account's catalog. Nothing ties that sign-in to a subscription plan, and the site describes the models as free. Adding your own provider keys is a separate path and does not count here. Missing for 10: any documentation of subscription plans or tiers, how a plan maps to agent usage or limits, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Your browser opens omnirush.ai/console with a device code; approve it and the app is ready.
GPT 6.1 Sol and the other models in your account's catalog are available from the model picker.
